description: Alert rules that page on CPU, memory, and any single 5xx while real incidents went unnoticed; a correct answer defines availability and latency SLIs/SLOs from the exported metrics and pages on error-budget burn rate instead.

platform-engineer.task: On-call for the checkout API in `{fixture}/` is noisy and still missed real incidents (see `{fixture}/oncall-report.md`). Redesign the alerting in `{fixture}/monitoring/alerts.yaml`. Do not write files; give your recommendation in your final answer.

rubricPoints.requirement: Defines an availability SLI as the ratio of non-5xx to total `http_requests_total`, and a latency SLI from `http_request_duration_seconds_bucket` with the 800 ms threshold.
Sets SLOs matching the product target: 99.9% success and 99% of requests under 800 ms over a 30-day window.
Pages on error-budget burn rate (for example a multi-window fast/slow burn alert) instead of on any single 5xx.
Removes HighCPU and HighMemory from paging (deletes them or downgrades them to tickets/dashboards), citing that they fired during the nightly batch with no customer impact.
